Resolves #21803
Related: #21796

The selector now requires a concrete Playwright navigation pathname before narrowing example CSS. Conservative route expansion still retains possibly affected specs once a concrete owner witness qualifies. A missing or ambiguous witness keeps the full Engine tier.

Evidence: L2 (base and candidate selector controls, workflow tests, and current-tree examples) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` pins full coverage when a computed route visits only a sibling. The actual Carousel stylesheet previously narrowed through the Gallery/Helix spec and now returns full. |
| AC-2 | The same spec covers fixed pathnames with dynamic query strings, retention of computed reach and unnamed controls, and full coverage when literal URLs or shadowed bindings give insufficient evidence. The current-tree Gantt Task Columns, Scheduler Event Editor, Zoom, Live Updates, and Board Big Data examples all still narrow. |
| AC-3 | `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` pins the existing workflow outputs and tier boundaries alongside conditional parser setup. |

## Deltas from ticket

Change class: restoration. The classifier materializes the existing lockfile's Acorn parser only when a PR has an example CSS candidate, with package scripts disabled. Parser unavailability retains full coverage. The package and lockfile are unchanged. Engine does not host `agent-preflight`; this branch uses the shared PR baseline.

## Test Evidence

The computed-route and unused-literal tests both failed at `5c8d14ab26` with `full=false`. On the candidate, the selector, reach, and workflow classifier suites pass. The exact current-tree selector restores full coverage for Carousel while the five original examples retain narrowed coverage.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Include the conditional parser setup in #21796's three-PR hosted timing comparison.
